newsitem.title: USA: Imperial Credit unit files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Credit unit files for IPO.

text.p: Imperial Credit Industries Inc said Friday that its unit Imperial Credit Commercial Mortgage Investment Corp has filed a registration statement for a proposed initial public offering of 20 million shares of common stock.

All of the shares are being offered by the company. Of the shares being offered, 1.98 million shares will be sold to Imperial Credit Industries Inc at the initial public offering price net of underwriting discounts or commissions.
Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc and Jefferies & Co Inc will co-manage the underwriting group and have been granted and underwriters' over-allotment option of 3 million shares.
The offering is expected in late September at an estimated price of $15.00 per share.

Imperial Credit Commercial Mortgage Investment Corp. expects to become a real estate investment trust and intends to invest primarily in performing multifamily and commercial term loans and interests in multifamily and commercial mortgage backed securities.
